name: Glockenhof
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated in Walchsee, the Glockenhof features welcoming hospitality, comfortable rooms, and tasty regional dining. It makes a versatile year-round holiday destination.

Lake Walchsee beaches, the Zahmer Kaiser cable cars, and extensive cross-country ski trails are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Glockenhof in Walchsee provides peaceful alpine relaxation in the scenic Kaiserwinkl.
